findings.quote: Some people finish in several months, and others need more than a year.
findings.why: The treatment-length range is not backed by any link or source, and the ficha contains no aligner timeline data.
findings.fix: Remove the numeric range or attribute it to a cited source, and keep the statement that only an exam gives a real estimate.

findings.quote: Skipping wear time is one of the common reasons treatment runs longer than planned
findings.why: The claim that skipped wear time is a common cause of delay is presented as fact without a supporting source.
findings.fix: Reword it as general guidance (for example, 'Skipping wear time can make treatment take longer') or link to an ADA or clinic source that supports it.

findings.quote: That may not feel like a satisfying answer, so here is what shapes the timeline and what to expect along the way.
findings.why: The sentence is generic filler that anticipates the reader's reaction, a common AI-drafted pattern that adds no patient information.
findings.fix: Delete the sentence and open the next section directly with the factors that affect treatment length.
